theme: Light mode primary with Dark mode toggle. High-contrast utility.

rules: No Inter for headings. No Space Grotesk.
Tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for large headers.
6th-grade reading level plain language across all copy.

colors.archetype: The Performance Pro / Swiss Brutalist hybrid.
rules: Never use pure black or gray, tint neutral greys with blue (cool).
Use #1B2A4A as primary anchor and #E8743B as the kinetic trigger for actions.

surface_strategies: Sharp edges, cardless or max 8px border-radius.
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or Dropdowns.
shadows_and_depth: Use 1px solid strokes or 2px inner glow highlights instead of soft shadows.
Glassmorphism (12-24px blur) with backdrop-saturate for sticky headers.

component_instructions.buttons: EVERY button MUST have a text label (icon + word, NEVER icon alone).
component_instructions.instruction_banners: EVERY screen MUST have a one-line instruction banner telling the user what to do.
component_instructions.header: MUST include 'Data: live from Airtable' indicator with manual refresh button AND a Global Privacy Mode toggle.
component_instructions.privacy_mode: When toggled, blurs/masks every customer name, phone, email, address, and dollar figure across ALL views (persisted in localStorage).
component_instructions.leads_timer: Live 'age' timer for New leads. Turns RED if > 5 minutes.
component_instructions.navigation: Persistent left sidebar on desktop. Bottom tab bar on mobile.

views_required.Dashboard: KPI cards (uncontacted New leads with oldest wait time turning RED if >5 min, open leads, pipeline value, booked revenue, collected, outstanding, monthly burn). Doughnut chart (leads by status). Bar chart (money overview). Upcoming jobs list. High-priority tasks list.
views_required.Leads: Card grid ONLY (NOT a table). Live 'age' timer for New leads turning red past 5 mins. Action buttons (Call, Email, Quote, Deposit, Book as job). Status dropdown. Filter chips. '+ New lead' modal. 'Quote calculator' modal showing price RANGES.
views_required.Projects: Job list sorted by date, editable.
views_required.To-Do Board: 4-column drag-and-drop kanban (Backlog, To Do, In Progress, Done) with priority + category pills, red overdue dates.
views_required.Invoices: KPI row + table with status dropdown and one-click Mark paid.
views_required.Partner View: Read-only financial summary, NO customer names.

grids.dashboard: High Density Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4) with tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).

layouts.app_shell: Desktop: Left Sidebar (w-64) + Main Content. Mobile: Main Content + Bottom Tab Bar.
layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Tailwind Scale p-4, p-6, p-8. Containers with borders must have internal padding.

motion.interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements. Explicitly set text color.
motion.transitions: Specific properties only (e.g. transition-colors, transition-transform). No 'transition-all'.

accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attribute.

media.icons: Use lucide-react (default). Never use AI assistant Emoji characters.
media.charts: Use Recharts or Shadcn chart components. Doughnut and Bar charts required.

3d_libraries.usage: Not required for this high-density CRM utility app. Stick to clean 2D data visualization.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Share the guideline for .js files not for .tsx files.
Do not converge toward generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Make creative, distinctive frontends.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js
Ensure the app is styled as a PWA (mobile-responsive, installable).
